description:
Land parcels by size and how much of them is built on. Set
    `max_built_coverage` to 0.2 to find largely undeveloped plots.

    Parcels with NO measured coverage are excluded when you set a ceiling,
    rather than counted as empty — unknown coverage is not evidence of a vacant
    plot. Coverage is measured on about 41% of parcels.

    UK only. Costs 30 credits (30p).
name: plot_utilisation
title: Plot utilisation of land parcels
